decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 5 - As shown on the drawings hereby approved, the front garden wall shall be re-instated to match the existing wall, except at the points of access, before the access is first brought into use and shall be permanently retained thereafter.

Condition : 7 - A replacement tree shall be planted within the forecourt of the property within one year of the removal of the tree on the front boundary, within the first planting season following the removal of the tree, i.e. between October and March.
description: Formation of a means of access to the highway
